expect.bodytext: The best Easter scenes usually depend on restraint. Once the eggs are placed in a believable spring setting, the season speaks for itself. Grass, flowers, and a little space around the objects are often enough.

expect.bodytext: Colored eggs tucked into fresh grass remain one of the clearest Easter images for a reason. The contrast between bright shells and new green growth captures the season in a single glance. It feels playful without needing explanation, and it works equally well for children, families, and simple spring editorial content.
